teaser.en: The sticky brown pulp of the tamarind pod sours porridge, fish sauce and cold drinks right across the coast.
teaser.sw: Unga wa kahawia unaonata wa kaka la ukwaju huongeza uchachu kwenye uji, mchuzi wa samaki na vinywaji baridi kote pwani.
teaser.dg: Unga wa rangi ya dongo unaonyata wa kpwadzu unahenda uji, mtsuzi wa ng'onda na vinwadzi vya mnyevu vikale vya ngbwadu kosi pwani.

summary.en: *Mkpwadzu* is the tamarind, a long-lived tree of villages and bush whose pods hold a sour, sticky pulp. The Digo use it for food and drink, carve its hard wood into mortars and pestles, and use it in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mkpwadzu* ni mkwaju, mti unaoishi muda mrefu wa vijijini na vichakani ambao makaka yake yana nyama ya uchachu inayonata. Wadigo huutumia kwa chakula na vinywaji, huchonga mbao zake ngumu kuwa vinu na michi, na huutumia katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mkpwadzu* ni muhi unaokala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu, wa vidzidzi na weruni, ambao makakayage gana unga wa ngbwadu unaonyata. Adigo anauhumira kpwa chakurya na vinwadzi, anatsonga nyama za muhi uhu, ambazo ni ngumu, kuhenda vinu na mitsi, na anauhumira kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mkpwadzu* is a large, slow-growing evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown that casts deep shade. Its leaves are feathery, made of ten to eighteen pairs of small leaflets that fold together at night.

The fruit is a curved brown pod with a thin, brittle shell. Inside, a sticky, sour brown pulp clings to hard, shiny seeds. Big old trees can live for a very long time and become landmarks in a village.
about.sw:
*Mkpwadzu* ni mti mkubwa unaokua polepole, wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima na taji nene la mviringo linaloweka kivuli kizito. Majani yake ni kama manyoya, yakiwa na jozi kumi hadi kumi na nane za vijani vidogo vinavyojikunja pamoja usiku.

Tunda ni kaka la kahawia lililopinda lenye ganda jembamba linalovunjika kwa urahisi. Ndani yake, nyama ya kahawia inayonata yenye uchachu hushikamana na mbegu ngumu zinazong'aa. Miti mikubwa mizee inaweza kuishi muda mrefu sana na kuwa alama mashuhuri kijijini.
about.dg:
*Mkpwadzu* ni muhi mkulu unaokula pore-pore na wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa chizito cha mviringo chinachoreha pepho kulu. Makodzage ni dza manyoya, ga jozi kumi hadi kumi na nane za makodza madide ganagokundzana usiku.

Tunda ni kakaya ririrootyoka ra rangi ya dongo, renye chivo chembamba chinachovundzika rahisi. Ndani, unga wa ngbwadu unaonyata wa rangi ya dongo unagbwirira tembe ngumu zinazong'ala. Mikpwadzu mikulu ya kare inaweza kukala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu sana na kukala alama ya chidzidzi.

where.en: Tamarind grows in bushland, wooded grassland and around village sites. On the south coast the large trees are easiest to spot standing in villages and along the edges of the bush, where people have kept them for generations.
where.sw: Mkwaju hustawi vichakani, katika nyika zenye miti na kuzunguka maeneo ya vijiji. Katika pwani ya kusini miti mikubwa ni rahisi zaidi kuiona ikiwa imesimama vijijini na pembezoni mwa vichaka, ambako watu wameihifadhi kwa vizazi.
where.dg: Mkpwadzu unamera weruni, kpwa nyasi zenye mihi na kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi. Kpwa pwani ya kusini, mihi mikulu ni rahisi zaidi kuiona ichiima kpwa vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya weruni, phatu ambapho atu akairinda kpwa vizazi na vizazi.

uses.en:
The pulp is the prize. It is used to sour porridge, made into juice and drinks, and stirred into chutneys and fish sauces. The seeds are fried and eaten.

The wood is hard and is carved into mortars and pestles. The tree is also used in medicine: the Digo of Diani boil the roots and leaves as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw:
Nyama ndiyo hazina. Hutumika kuongeza uchachu kwenye uji, hutengenezwa sharubati na vinywaji, na huchanganywa katika chatini na michuzi ya samaki. Mbegu hukaangwa na kuliwa.

Mbao zake ni ngumu na huchongwa kuwa vinu na michi. Mti huu pia hutumika katika dawa: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi na majani kama tiba ya malaria.
uses.dg:
Unga ndio chitu cha samani zaidi. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda uji ukale wa ngbwadu, nkuhendwa juisi na vinwadzi, na nkutsanganywa kpwa chatini na mitsuzi ya ng'onda. Tembe nkukalangwa na kuriwa.

Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na nkutsongbwa kuhenda vinu na mitsi. Muhi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa: Adigo a Diani nkujita mizi na makodza dza dawa ya homa (malaria).

culture.en: The name *mkpwadzu* is shared with the Duruma, Giriama and Swahili neighbours, and its *kpw* spelling captures the Digo pronunciation. The word *mkpwadzu* has a second meaning too: a walking stick.
culture.sw: Jina *mkpwadzu* linashirikiwa na majirani Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili, na maandishi yake ya *kpw* yanaonyesha matamshi ya Kidigo. Neno *mkpwadzu* lina maana ya pili pia: bakora.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkpwadzu* ni sawa na ra Aduruma, Agiryama na Aswahili, ambao ni majirani a Adigo, na maandikoge ga *kpw* ganaonyesa vira Adigo anavyorigomba. Neno *mkpwadzu* rina mana ya phiri piya: mseche.

names.en: The tree is *mkpwadzu*, also written *mkwadzu*; the fruit is *kpwadzu* or *likpwadzu* (plural *makpwadzu*). The ICRAF handbook writes *mkwadzu*, while Pakia and Mgombato use the Digo spelling with *kpw*. Swahili calls the tree *mkwaju* and the fruit *ukwaju*, and Giriama also uses *mkwaju*. In English it is tamarind.
names.sw: Mti ni *mkpwadzu*, pia huandikwa *mkwadzu*; tunda ni *kpwadzu* au *likpwadzu* (wingi *makpwadzu*). Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinaandika *mkwadzu*, huku Pakia na Mgombato wakitumia maandishi ya Kidigo yenye *kpw*. Kiswahili huuita mti *mkwaju* na tunda *ukwaju*, na Kigiriama pia hutumia *mkwaju*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *tamarind*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mkpwadzu*, piya unaandikpwa *mkwadzu*; tunda ni *kpwadzu* au *likpwadzu* (wingi *makpwadzu*). Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mkwadzu*, ela Pakia na Mgombato anahumira maandiko ga Chidigo ga *kpw*. Chiswahili chinauiha muhi *mkwaju* na tunda *ukwaju*, na Chigiryama piya chinahumira *mkwaju*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *tamarind*.

definition.en: The tamarind pod. Mgombato also lists it as likpwadzu (plural makpwadzu).
definition.sw: Kaka la ukwaju. Mgombato pia analiorodhesha kama likpwadzu (wingi makpwadzu).
definition.dg: Kakaya ra mkpwadzu. Mgombato piya inariandika dza *likpwadzu* (wingi *makpwadzu*).
